chat.author: Chris Box
chat.text: Mike wrote "I presume that Level 0 on the moderation ladder is "Just talk to them". So presumably you're going to formal moderation because Level 0 failed." The ladder counts incidents, so yes if you don't consider it's an incident, then the ladder is not relevant. However if it is an incident (i.e. it is disrupting the WG) then you should create an incident. This does not require you to impose a remedy. The procedures say "The number of eligible incidents, including the one being handled, sets the maximum remedy available. The incident register computes this and tells the acting administrator the maximum. Any remedy up to and including that maximum may be applied - or none at all. In general, the minimal action necessary should be taken."
